case_level_notes: Valid frivolous/irrelevant termination eliminates downstream reinvestigation, furnisher-notice, and results-notice duties. Termination notice met statutory timing and content requirements.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Not applicable branch only; no claim about subsequent reporting compliance beyond scope.

material_facts.fact: Narrative does not mention a consumer statement

determinations.rationale: No consumer statement was filed; branch not applicable.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Consideration duty does not attach when termination is valid.

material_facts.fact: CRA made a frivolous-or-irrelevant determination
Submission lacked account, field, and basis

determinations.rationale: Dispute was terminated as frivolous due to insufficient information; no reinvestigation duty to perform consideration arose.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Furnisher-notice duty inapplicable when valid frivolous termination applies.

material_facts.fact: No furnisher notice was sent
Frivolous termination made

determinations.rationale: Because dispute was validly terminated as frivolous, the CRA was not obligated to send furnisher notice.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Determination reflects that reinvestigation was not required, consistent with packet.

material_facts.fact: Submission did not identify account, field, or basis
CRA made frivolous determination

determinations.rationale: The dispute packet did not identify the account, disputed field, or basis; valid frivolous/irrelevant termination applies, so no reinvestigation was required.

determinations.rationale: No reinvestigation was required; timing duty does not apply.

determinations.rationale: The CRA executed a valid frivolous/irrelevant termination with timely (3 business day) notice that identified the missing account and disputed information and explained what was needed.

determinations.rationale: No CRA-to-furnisher notice was sent because of valid termination; furnisher indirect duties not triggered.

determinations.rationale: No routing triggers (identity theft, mixed-file, missing documents, date conflicts, manual review policy) appear in this narrative. The case is a clean frivolous termination.

determinations.rationale: No reinvestigation occurred, so a results notice was not required. The frivolous-termination notice (a separate duty) was timely sent.
